name: Natural Language Processing
certifications: No single standard certification; assessed by projects
Optional: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer

beginner.summary: For developers, analysts and data scientists new to NLP. Covers text data and its problems, Python text handling, regular expressions, tokenisation, normalisation, spaCy pipelines, part-of-speech tagging, named entities, bag of words and TF-IDF, text classification, evaluation, sentiment analysis, word embeddings, topic modelling, text similarity, keyword extraction, Indian languages and responsible NLP.
prerequisites: Writes Python with lists, dictionaries and functions
Basic machine learning ideas such as training and testing are helpful
outcomes: Clean and tokenise text in English and Indian languages
Build classic NLP pipelines with spaCy and scikit-learn
Classify text, find entities and topics and measure results
Use embeddings for similarity and explain NLP risks

days.topic: NLP Overview, Applications and Environment Setup
subtopics: What NLP is and where it is used
Tasks: classification, extraction, search, translation and generation
Large language models and classic NLP together
Installing Python, Jupyter, spaCy and NLTK
Course datasets: product reviews, support tickets and news
Choosing an approach for a business problem
days.lab_task: Set up the environment, load the three course datasets, look at examples from each and choose an approach for five business problems with reasons.
days.deliverable: Environment set-up and an approach table
checks: Tokens and entities shown for a sentence

days.topic: Working with Text Data in Python
subtopics: Reading text files, CSV and JSON
days.lab_task: Load support tickets with mixed encodings, fix broken characters, measure text lengths, detect languages and remove duplicates.

subtopics: Extracting emails, phone numbers and IDs
Regex for Indian formats: PIN codes and mobile numbers
days.lab_task: Extract order IDs, emails, Indian mobile numbers and PIN codes from tickets, mask personal data and test patterns against tricky examples.
days.deliverable: Regex patterns, tests and masked text
checks: All valid numbers found and invalid ones skipped

days.lab_task: Tokenise reviews with NLTK and spaCy, compare stemming and lemmatisation, decide which stop words to keep for sentiment and handle emojis.
checks: Differences on contractions and URLs recorded

subtopics: The pipeline: tokenizer, tagger, parser and NER
days.lab_task: Process 50,000 reviews with nlp.pipe, disable unneeded components, add a custom component that flags product names with PhraseMatcher and save the pipeline.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code, timings and saved pipeline
checks: Faster with nlp.pipe and disabled components

days.lab_task: Extract product features and the words describing them from reviews using noun chunks and dependency relations, and visualise five parses.
Find people, companies and places in news, add rule-based entities for product codes, annotate 100 sentences and measure precision and recall.

days.topic: Bag of Words and TF-IDF Features
days.lab_task: Build count and TF-IDF features for tickets with unigrams and bigrams, tune vocabulary settings and list the top words per ticket category.
checks: Useful phrases appear in top features
Words make sense for each category

days.topic: Text Classification with Classic Machine Learning
subtopics: Train and test splits for text
days.lab_task: Classify support tickets into categories with Naive Bayes, logistic regression and a linear SVM in pipelines, handle imbalance and save the best model.
checks: Scores on the same test set

days.lab_task: Evaluate the ticket classifier with macro and micro F1, read the confusion matrix, review 30 errors and find a leakage problem caused by template text.
Compare VADER, a trained classifier and a pretrained transformer on product reviews, test negation and sarcasm examples and report sentiment by product feature.
checks: Scores on the same labelled set

subtopics: Training embeddings on your own data
days.lab_task: Train Word2Vec on tickets, compare with pretrained fastText vectors, find similar words, visualise clusters and check for gender bias.
days.deliverable: Trained embeddings, visualisation and bias check

days.lab_task: Find topics in support tickets with LDA and NMF, choose the number of topics with coherence, label them and compare with BERTopic.

subtopics: Use cases: FAQ matching and duplicate tickets
days.lab_task: Find duplicate tickets with MinHash, build semantic search over FAQs with sentence embeddings and FAISS and evaluate it with 30 test questions.
days.deliverable: Deduplication results, search index and evaluation
checks: Right FAQ in the top three for most questions

days.lab_task: Extract keywords from news with YAKE and KeyBERT, build an extractive summariser, compare with a pretrained abstractive model and score both with ROUGE.
days.deliverable: Keyword lists, summaries and ROUGE scores

days.topic: NLP for Indian Languages and Multilingual Text
subtopics: Scripts and Unicode for Indian languages
Multilingual models such as IndicBERT and MuRIL
days.lab_task: Normalise Hindi and Tamil text, transliterate Hinglish reviews, translate tickets to English and classify sentiment with a multilingual model.
Extract invoice number, date, vendor and total from 50 PDF invoices, including scanned ones with OCR, validate the values and route uncertain ones for review.

days.topic: Building a Simple Chatbot and Intent Classifier
subtopics: When to use an LLM instead
tools: Rasa or a custom Python bot
days.lab_task: Build a bot for order status and returns with intent classification, slot filling for order numbers, a fallback and conversation tests.
checks: Intent recognised and order number captured

days.topic: Responsible NLP: Bias, Privacy and Harm
days.lab_task: Redact personal data from tickets with Presidio, test the classifier for unfair errors across dialects and write a model card.
days.deliverable: Redacted data, fairness results and model card

days.lab_task: Build a ticket system that cleans and redacts tickets, classifies them, extracts order numbers, finds duplicates, suggests FAQ answers with semantic search and reports topics and sentiment, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, evaluation report and demo recording
checks: Right answer in the top three for most tickets
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one system

intermediate.summary: For data scientists and engineers building NLP systems. Covers neural networks for text, recurrent models, attention, the transformer architecture, tokenisers, pretrained encoders, fine-tuning for classification, token classification and question answering, sentence embeddings, retrieval, LLM prompting for NLP tasks, structured extraction with LLMs, evaluation, data annotation, efficient models, serving, multilingual transformers, speech in brief and production monitoring.
prerequisites: Builds classic NLP pipelines with spaCy and scikit-learn
Writes PyTorch or is ready to learn it
outcomes: Fine-tune and evaluate transformer models for core NLP tasks
Build embedding-based retrieval and use LLMs for NLP tasks well
Create labelled data and make models efficient
Serve and monitor NLP models in production

days.topic: Neural Networks for Text with PyTorch
days.lab_task: Build a neural ticket classifier with an embedding layer in PyTorch, train it on a GPU with early stopping and compare with the TF-IDF baseline.
checks: Validation loss falls then stops improving
Training stops at the best epoch
Scores on the same test set

days.lab_task: Train a bidirectional LSTM for named entities on a small dataset, compare it with the spaCy model and explain its weaknesses on long sentences.
Implement scaled dot-product attention, visualise attention weights in a pretrained model and map BERT, GPT and T5 to their architectures.
days.deliverable: Attention code, visualisations and architecture notes

subtopics: Subword tokenisation: BPE, WordPiece and SentencePiece
days.lab_task: Compare how three tokenisers split English and Hindi text, train a tokeniser on support tickets and fix a truncation bug that cuts off labels.
checks: Domain terms kept as fewer tokens

subtopics: Pretrained encoders: BERT, RoBERTa and DeBERTa
days.lab_task: Fine-tune DeBERTa and DistilBERT to classify tickets, tune learning rate and epochs, handle imbalance and compare with the classic baseline.
Fine-tune a transformer for product and order entities, fix label alignment for subwords, evaluate with seqeval and add rules for codes.
Fine-tune an extractive QA model on policy documents, handle long documents with sliding windows and unanswerable questions, and evaluate with exact match and F1.

subtopics: Evaluation: recall at k and MRR
days.lab_task: Fine-tune an embedding model on FAQ pairs with hard negatives, add a cross-encoder re-ranker and measure recall at 5 and MRR before and after.
days.deliverable: Fine-tuned model, retrieval pipeline and evaluation

subtopics: Choosing between fine-tuned models and LLMs
days.lab_task: Classify tickets with zero-shot and few-shot prompts on a hosted and a local model, compare accuracy, cost and latency with the fine-tuned classifier.
checks: Per-ticket cost and time for each

days.lab_task: Extract invoice fields into a pydantic schema with an LLM, validate and retry on errors, measure field accuracy against the rule-based extractor and redact data before sending.
Build slice and robustness tests for the classifier, run behavioural tests for negation and typos, run a small human evaluation and test whether two models really differ.
days.deliverable: Test suite, human evaluation and evaluation report

days.lab_task: Write guidelines, label 300 tickets with two annotators, add weak labels with labelling functions, generate synthetic examples for a rare class and version the dataset.
checks: Agreement above the target after guideline fixes
Coverage and accuracy of labelling functions reported

days.topic: Efficient NLP Models: Distillation, Quantisation and ONNX
days.lab_task: Distil the ticket classifier, quantise it, export to ONNX and compare latency on CPU and accuracy with the original.
checks: Same predictions as PyTorch on samples

days.lab_task: Generate product descriptions with greedy, beam and sampling settings, compare fluency, variety and factual errors, and force valid JSON with constrained decoding.
days.deliverable: Generation outputs, comparison and settings guide
checks: Fluency and variety rated for each
All outputs parse as valid JSON

subtopics: Pretrained translation models: NLLB, MarianMT and IndicTrans2
Translation with LLMs compared with dedicated models
days.lab_task: Translate support articles from English to Hindi with NLLB and IndicTrans2, fine-tune on a small domain set, apply a glossary and compare automatic and human scores.
checks: BLEU, chrF and COMET for each

subtopics: Text Generation Inference and vLLM in brief
days.lab_task: Serve the classifier and NER models in one FastAPI service with batching and caching, containerise it and load test it.
days.deliverable: Service, Dockerfile and load test results
checks: p95 latency at the target rate

subtopics: Multilingual models: XLM-R, MuRIL and IndicBERT
Speech-to-text for Indian languages in brief
days.lab_task: Fine-tune MuRIL for sentiment on Hindi and Tamil reviews, test cross-lingual transfer from English and compare with translate-then-classify.

days.topic: Speech and Text: ASR and Text-to-Speech in Brief
days.lab_task: Transcribe call recordings with Whisper, split speakers, classify call reasons from transcripts and measure word error rate for two accents.

subtopics: What changes in text over time
days.lab_task: Monitor the classifier for text and prediction drift, simulate a new product launch that changes vocabulary, detect it and trigger retraining with new labels.
days.deliverable: Monitoring set-up, drift report and retraining record

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Multilingual Customer Insight Platform
days.lab_task: Build a multilingual platform that classifies and extracts entities from tickets in English, Hindi and Tamil, retrieves answers with fine-tuned embeddings, serves optimised models and monitors drift, then present results.
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For senior NLP engineers and researchers. Covers pretraining and continued pretraining, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, instruction tuning, preference optimisation, long-context models, advanced retrieval, knowledge graphs, information extraction at scale, LLM evaluation, safety and red teaming, guardrails, low-resource languages, model compression, NLP system design, serving at scale, privacy, regulation, research methods and leading NLP teams.
prerequisites: Builds retrieval systems and uses LLM APIs
outcomes: Adapt and align language models for specific domains
Build advanced retrieval, extraction and knowledge systems
Evaluate, secure and govern language systems
Design NLP systems at scale and lead NLP work

days.topic: Pretraining and Continued Pretraining of Language Models
subtopics: Data collection and cleaning at scale
days.lab_task: Continue pretraining a small model on legal or medical text, extend its tokeniser with domain terms and measure perplexity and downstream task gains.
days.deliverable: Training run, tokeniser changes and evaluation
checks: Lower on domain text after training

days.lab_task: Fine-tune an open 7B model with QLoRA for ticket triage, compare ranks, merge the adapter and serve several adapters on one base model.
checks: Requests routed to the right adapter

days.lab_task: Build an instruction dataset for support tasks with human and synthetic examples, check contamination with test sets, tune a model and evaluate instruction following.
checks: No test items in training data

days.topic: Preference Optimisation: RLHF, DPO and Related Methods
days.lab_task: Collect preference pairs for support answers, train with DPO, compare with the instruction-tuned model on helpfulness and safety and look for reward hacking.
days.deliverable: Preference data, DPO model and comparison

days.lab_task: Compare long-context prompting with retrieval for contract questions, run needle-in-a-haystack tests and parse document layout before chunking.

days.topic: Advanced Retrieval: Hybrid, Multi-Vector and Query Rewriting
days.lab_task: Build hybrid retrieval with BM25 and dense vectors, add ColBERT, query rewriting and re-ranking, and measure each step's effect on quality and latency.

subtopics: Entity and relation extraction for graphs
days.lab_task: Extract companies, people and relations from news into Neo4j, resolve duplicate entities, answer multi-hop questions with GraphRAG and compare with plain retrieval.

subtopics: Extraction pipelines for millions of documents
days.lab_task: Design an extraction pipeline for two million documents that uses rules first, a small model next and an LLM only when needed, with review queues and quality monitoring.
days.deliverable: Pipeline design, cost model and quality dashboard
checks: Share handled by each stage reported

days.lab_task: Build an evaluation suite for a support assistant with task tests, hallucination checks and pairwise judging, test judge bias and run it in CI for every change.
days.deliverable: Evaluation suite, bias analysis and CI runs
checks: Rate reported on the test set

days.topic: Safety, Red Teaming and Adversarial Attacks
days.lab_task: Red-team a support assistant for jailbreaks and prompt injection, attack the classifier with TextAttack, apply mitigations and re-measure attack success.
days.deliverable: Red team report and mitigation results

days.lab_task: Build input and output guardrails for an assistant, a moderation classifier for user comments with human review and measure precision, recall and latency.

days.topic: NLP for Low-Resource and Indian Languages at Scale
subtopics: Community and government datasets such as Bhashini
days.lab_task: Build a ticket classifier for five Indian languages with transfer learning and limited labels, evaluate per language and dialect and plan data collection for the weakest.
days.deliverable: Models, per-language evaluation and data plan

subtopics: Running models on phones and browsers
days.lab_task: Distil an assistant into a small model, quantise it, run it on a laptop CPU and in a browser and compare quality, speed and memory.
Write a design document for a multilingual email triage system with routing between rules, a small model and an LLM, cost budgets and a feedback loop, and defend it.
checks: Each path justified by cost and accuracy
Latency and cost targets met by design

subtopics: Serving engines: vLLM, TGI and TensorRT-LLM
days.lab_task: Serve an open model with vLLM and TensorRT-LLM, turn on speculative decoding, add prompt caching and a router to a smaller model, and compare cost per million tokens.

subtopics: Personal data in text and models
Federated learning for keyboards and devices
days.lab_task: Test a fine-tuned model for memorised personal data, retrain with redacted data and differential privacy, and compare utility and leakage.
days.deliverable: Leakage tests, retrained model and comparison
checks: Leaked strings found before the fix

days.topic: Regulation, Governance and Documentation for Language AI
subtopics: EU AI Act duties for language systems
Documentation: model cards and data statements
tools: Model card and data statement templates
days.lab_task: Classify three language systems under the EU AI Act, write data statements and model cards, and run a governance review of one system.

subtopics: Contributing to open source and datasets
days.lab_task: Reproduce a recent NLP paper's main result, run an ablation, test significance and write a short report on whether to adopt the method.
checks: Close to the paper or gaps explained

subtopics: Working with product and legal teams
days.lab_task: Write a 12-month roadmap for a language AI product team with hiring, data, model and evaluation plans and value measures, and present it to a role-play executive team.
checks: Model and data risks with owners

days.lab_task: Build a domain assistant for a regulated industry: adapt an open model with QLoRA and DPO, add hybrid retrieval and a knowledge graph, guardrails and red teaming, an evaluation suite in CI, serving at a cost target and governance documentation, then present to a review board.
days.deliverable: Models, retrieval system, evaluation reports, serving set-up and board presentation
checks: Design, cost and risk choices defended
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one assistant
